docs.title: On-Premises Three-Tier LAMP Platform
docs.text:
A highly available enterprise web application architecture built on on-premises Linux infrastructure.

The platform follows a classic three-tier architecture:

  • Web Tier — Linux + Apache
  • Application Tier — Linux + PHP
  • Database Tier — Linux + MySQL/MariaDB
